changelog:
Search gives every provider its own results, and an update can no longer leave the app unable to open after an interrupted refresh.

WHAT CHANGED

- Search: every provider you have on is searched on its own, up to 60 results each, so a provider with many matching names no longer hides the others. Names that start with what you typed show at once; names where each word you typed starts a word of the name are added after, in any order ("network nfl" finds "NFL Network"). The combined list is sorted by how well it matches: an exact name first, then names that start with your search, then the rest.
- Search no longer matches the middle of a word: "sport" finds "Sport 1" and "Sky Sport", not "Eurosport".
- Multi-view: the channel picker's search now works the same way as the main search. Before, it only found names that start with what you typed. One typed character shows the full list instead of searching.
- Fixed: if the app was closed or updated while it was refreshing two or more providers, the next update could leave it unable to open its catalog, with clearing the app's data as the only way back. The update now repairs this by itself.
- After an update that rebuilds the catalog's indexes, the first searches and lists are no longer slower than usual.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.14: multi-view closing a cell whose decoder fails, cells without sound stopping in the background, the automatic extra buffering, the catalog refresh counts, the Continue Watching rail and the unpair retry.
